water.name: Water, bottled, generic
water.reason: Explicit potable-water fallback; IFCT text search otherwise confuses water with water chestnut and coconut water.

salt.name: Salt, table
salt.reason: Explicit table-salt identity; resolver ranking otherwise places salted butter first.

whole_wheat_flour.name: Wheat flour, atta (Triticum aestivum)
whole_wheat_flour.reason: Indian atta is the specified whole-wheat flour for this slot.

urad_dal.name: Black gram, dal (Phaseolus mungo)
urad_dal.reason: Urad dal is split black gram; the common name differs from the IFCT canonical name.

onion.name: Onion, big (Allium cepa)
onion.reason: Explicit reviewed default for ordinary bulb onion; onion stalk and small onion remain distinct candidates.

egg.name: Egg, poultry, whole, raw
egg.reason: Recipe ingredient is whole raw poultry egg before cooking; omelette and separated egg rows are materially different.

cashew_optional.name: Cashew nut (Anacardium occidentale)
cashew_optional.reason: Exact cashew-nut identity; optional describes presence, not food identity.

cream_optional.name: Cream, fluid, heavy whipping
cream_optional.reason: Explicit heavy-cream default for rich North Indian gravy; optional describes presence.

sugar_optional.name: Sugars, granulated
sugar_optional.reason: Explicit granulated-sugar identity where the slot does not permit jaggery.
